subject: authored 17k-vertex Berdly arm drawn in game through the hand hook

asset.format: HYPRMESH v1: 48-byte header, 18-float records (position, normal, uv0, uv1, tangent, bitangent), u32 indices

mechanism.loading: hand-mesh.bin read and validated during mod initialization, never on the render thread
mechanism.upload: same private VAO/VBO/IBO layout as the cube; engine buffers untouched
mechanism.draw: authored index count of 25,620 in place of the hand's 1,188

visual_result.appearance: a winged claw silhouette with a raised palm and spread digits, centered and oversized, lit by the game's hand material

limitations: The arm is oversized and centered; it must be scaled down and moved to the lower right.
It samples the game's gold hand atlas; a blue feather texture is not bound yet.
It is static bind-pose geometry; the baked actions and feather springs are not applied yet.
The binary is generated from the GLB and is installed into the mod state directory for testing, not committed.
next_step: Fit scale and offset for a lower-right first-person pose, then bind our own blue feather texture and skin the mesh with the baked actions.
